purpose: Export a bounded, signed, provider-independent snapshot of AXIOM project-continuity evidence that can be verified offline and used to plan restoration without claiming complete external-forge history or authorizing provider mutation.
core_invariants: A project package preserves portable evidence; it does not make the exporter, import target, or provider authoritative over project history.
Package verification proves package integrity and exporter signature, not inclusion of the entire originating Grid chain.
Unmappable target-provider semantics remain retained evidence and are never silently discarded.
Private or sensitive protected content remains referenced by opaque commitments; the package does not require raw protected bytes.
claim_boundary: This contract does not prove that all GitHub, Forgejo, GitLab, Radicle, or other provider history has been captured.
This contract does not embed or verify the complete originating Grid chain; Grid anchors are exporter-attested evidence references.
This contract does not include protected content bytes merely because their commitments are present.
This contract does not perform provider restoration or mutation.
Histories larger than the bounded snapshot ceilings require a later segmented/chained package format rather than silent truncation.
